query: Please implement a Bayes database table website for solving scientific data problems. The website should have functionalities for detecting and predicting relationships between variables, inferring missing values, and finding similar database entries. Users should be able to input query statements, view data analysis results, including variable relationship graphs, prediction results, and missing value inferences. Assign moccasin as the background color and apply sandy brown to all elements.
